headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang and the stock rockets, CrowdStrike swallows Zscaler for $44bn, and Cyberpunk 2's director sets pulses racing with a 'cancelled' quip.

upcoming.what: Full 'Beaver' supermoon tonight, the first of four in a row
F1 Qatar GP, 16:00 Irish time (qualifying Sat 18:00, not a sprint weekend)
Cygnus CRS-25 launch to the ISS on Falcon 9, 15:47 Irish time
Rayman Legends Retold (PC, PS5, Xbox, Switch 2)
UFC Riyadh: Adesanya vs Magomedov, plus Ian Machado Garry vs Amosov (main card ~18:00 Irish)
F1 Abu Dhabi GP season finale, 13:00 Irish time

items.headline: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.summary: After a review found no national security risk, Nvidia's board restored Huang as CEO, president and director, and the stock reportedly closed up around 31%. He is due to testify publicly before US senators on 3 December.

items.headline: CrowdStrike agrees ~$44bn all-stock deal for Zscaler
items.summary: One of the biggest security deals ever pairs CrowdStrike's endpoint business with Zscaler's cloud network security, a notable shake-up for enterprise networking.

items.headline: Amazon confirms Decart deal, reportedly ~$7.5bn
items.summary: Following yesterday's reports, Amazon is taking much of Decart, including its AI optimisation stack and founding team.

items.headline: Industrial: HPE revenue up 50%, Myriota raises for satellite IoT
items.summary: HPE's Q4 revenue jumped to $14.5bn on AI servers and networking, though a cautious forecast knocked shares 6% after hours. Separately, Australia's Myriota raised about $40m for low-power satellite links for industrial sensors.

items.headline: Cygnus CRS-25 on track for Sunday
items.summary: Northrop Grumman's cargo ship is still targeting 15:47 Irish time on Sunday 29 Nov on a Falcon 9 with about 5 tonnes of supplies for the ISS. A quiet start to the week otherwise.

items.headline: Weekly roundup of space news
items.summary: A catch-up on the past week's launches and missions for anything you missed.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: mixed, clearing late under a full supermoon
items.summary: Mostly cloudy with a ~25% shower risk early evening, turning partly cloudy after about 21:00 with light winds and around 5°C; sunset about 16:20. Best window is late evening onwards for the full 'Beaver' supermoon, but its glare will drown faint targets. Wednesday looks foggy.

items.headline: Cyberpunk 2 director posts that the game is 'cancelled'
items.summary: The sequel's director wrote it was cancelled while describing a GTA 6-induced open-world slump. The wording reads as wry rather than an announcement, and CD Projekt Red hasn't confirmed anything, so treat it with caution.

items.headline: Witcher 4: Ciri is more hot-headed than Geralt
items.summary: A CD Projekt Red lead says playing as Ciri puts you closer to the story through her own perspective.

items.headline: Steam Awards nominate The Witcher 3 among decade's best
items.summary: This year's Steam Awards include a best-of-the-decade category, with The Witcher 3 up against Baldur's Gate 3, Elden Ring and Silksong.

items.headline: Xbox Project Helix was once pitched to run Steam games
items.summary: A report says Microsoft's next console started as a PC-like box with Steam support and free online play before that design was dropped. Nothing new on Borderlands 4 today.

items.headline: Quiet after Polaris 40; No-Gi Worlds next
items.summary: Little new since Garry Tonon's Polaris title win at the weekend. Next big date is the IBJJF No-Gi Worlds, 10-12 December.

items.headline: Quiet Monday; Ian Machado Garry vs Amosov is next
items.summary: No major new announcements found overnight and no UFC card this weekend. Next up is UFC Riyadh on 5 Dec, where Garry meets Amosov on the Adesanya vs Magomedov card.

items.headline: Vegas fallout: Verstappen hits out at Russell
items.summary: Verstappen's post-race comments about George Russell drew wide reaction, while Leclerc apologised for his clash with Hamilton.

items.headline: Ferrari plans changes before Qatar
items.summary: After the team-mate collision, Ferrari is reportedly reworking how it runs its drivers, with Qatar up this Sunday at 16:00 Irish time.

items.headline: Formula E hit by Stellantis pulling Opel and Citroën
items.summary: Stellantis is withdrawing two brands from Formula E, leaving the series scrambling. Quiet on the GT and endurance front.
